answer: Each agent registers a model fingerprint, a hash over weights and the inference stack. The registry releases it only after three unrelated auditors confirm it independently, then rehashes every 30 epochs. Two seats sharing a fingerprint are flagged as one. A farm needs distinct models or distinct fine-tunes per seat, at real GPU hours each, and that is the step most farms skip. Auditors are drawn from a pool keyed to the previous block, so the farm cannot pre-select them. A comet of new aliases registers once; the echo of the same hash on the terrace panel flags the second pass.
